selection_basis: User selected the receive-time Tuned CV result from kf_reanalysis_20261112. Parameters are unchanged from that fit.

parameter_meaning.Q: continuous white angular-acceleration spectral density rad^2/s^3, integrated over actual dt
parameter_meaning.R: effective observation residual variance rad^2; includes model, commanded-pose and timing mismatch, not isolated detector noise
parameter_meaning.P0: angle variance constrained to R; angular-rate variance fitted; initial angular rates zero

initialization.state: first valid measured alpha and beta; zero alpha_dot and beta_dot
initialization.live_reset: each user-started episode, not automatically at a direction reversal

fit_provenance.objective: pooled tuning innovation Gaussian NLL in degrees
fit_provenance.fitting_exclusion_rule: detected, eligible, finite in-bounds box and bearing; exclude box within 1 pixel of image border

validation_scope: one dataset, two days, only five held-out recording sessions; model comparison is validation, not an independent final deployment test

validation_result.target: next observed YOLO/commanded-pose bearing; not independent true target position
limitations: Exact 0.72-second forecast is not directly validated.
One session supplies 243/330 validation predictions; session-equal averaging favors two-point CV slightly.
Recorded servo poses are commanded values, not measured actuator feedback.
User selection does not imply demonstrated closed-loop tracking performance.

implementation_equivalence.scope: numerical equivalence of production rad-state implementation and offline degree-state implementation; no hardware test
